# Notebook 2 -- Fit & apply QM

**What this notebook does** (Steps 5-7 of `Suggestion-workflow.md`):

1. **Setup (Step 5):** For every model with all three aggregated variables
   (pr, tasmax, tasmin) and every Tier 1/2 catchment, fit an **empirical
   quantile mapping** from the CMIP6 catchment-mean series (source) to the
   CAMELS-India catchment-mean forcings (reference). Fits are **seasonal**
   (DJF/MAM/JJA/SON) with fallback to annual when a season bin has fewer than
   `r qed_min_quantile_sample` valid days; every fallback is logged.
2. **Apply & save (Step 6):** Apply each fitted mapping to the **full source
   series** (not only the overlap window), flag every extrapolated value, and
   write corrected CSVs + QM parameter files.
3. **Tier 3 handling (Step 7):** Option C -- exclude Tier 3 catchments from QM
   and document each one in `tier3_handling_log.csv`.

Directory layout produced here (inside `data_processed/qed/`):

```
qm_corrected/<model>/<tier>/<catchment_id>_<var>.csv   # date, source_value, corrected_value, method_flag
qm_params/<model>/<tier>/<catchment_id>_<var>.rds      # fitted quantile pairs
qm_run_summary.csv                                     # one row per model x catchment x var
tier3_handling_log.csv
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)
```

```{r log-file}
qed_log_file <- file.path(qed_output_dir, "qed_20_log.txt")
```

## 0. Inputs from notebook 10

```{r load-inventory}
inventory <- data.table::fread(file.path(qed_output_dir, "inventory.csv"),
                               colClasses = list(character = "id"))
# Catchments that receive QM: tiers 1 and 2 (forcing warning does not exclude)
qm_catch <- inventory[final_action %in% c("tier1", "tier2", "correct_with_warning")]
qm_catch[, tier := data.table::fifelse(final_action == "tier1", "tier1",
                    data.table::fifelse(final_action == "tier2", "tier2", "tier2"))]
cat("Catchments to correct:", nrow(qm_catch),
    "(tier1 =", sum(qm_catch$tier == "tier1"),
    "| tier2 =", sum(qm_catch$tier == "tier2"), ")\n")
```

## 1. Models: keep only those with all three variables

```{r model-discovery}
pr_files   <- list.files(qed_agg_dir, pattern = "^agg_pr_", full.names = TRUE)
models_pr  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(sub("^agg_pr_", "", basename(pr_files)))
tx_files   <- list.files(qed_agg_dir, pattern = "^agg_tasmax_", full.names = TRUE)
models_tx  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(sub("^agg_tasmax_", "", basename(tx_files)))
tn_files   <- list.files(qed_agg_dir, pattern = "^agg_tasmin_", full.names = TRUE)
models_tn  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(sub("^agg_tasmin_", "", basename(tn_files)))

qed_models <- if (qed_require_all_vars) {
   Reduce(intersect, list(models_pr, models_tx, models_tn))
} else union(models_pr, union(models_tx, models_tn))
cat("Models with all 3 variables:", length(qed_models), "\n")
cat(paste(qed_models, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (qed_test_mode) {
   qed_models <- qed_models[1:2]
   qm_catch   <- head(qm_catch, 3)
   cat("TEST MODE: reduced to", length(qed_models), "models,",
       nrow(qm_catch), "catchments\n")
}
```

## 2. Cache the reference forcings for Tier 1/2 catchments (read once)

```{r cache-forcing}
forcing_cache <- setNames(
   vector("list", nrow(qm_catch)), qm_catch$id)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(qm_catch))) {
   id <- qm_catch$id[i]
   f  <- qed_read_forcing(file.path(qed_forcing_dir, paste0(id, ".csv")))
   f  <- f[date >= qed_period_start & date <= qed_period_end]
   forcing_cache[[id]] <- f
}
```

## 3. Fit + apply, model by model

The loop below is deliberately **one model at a time** so only one model's agg
files live in memory. For each (model, catchment, variable):

* overlap window = source dates within `r format(qed_period_start)` ..
  `r format(qed_period_end)`;
* require overlap >= `r qed_min_days_for_qm` valid source days, else **skip and
  log** (no silent drop);
* fit per season where the season bin has >= `r qed_min_quantile_sample` valid
  days, else **fall back to the annual fit** and log it;
* apply to the **full** source series; extrapolation policy:
  pr -> `r qed_extrap_pr`, temperature -> `r qed_extrap_temp`.

```{r main-loop}
dir.create(file.path(qed_output_dir, "qm_corrected"), showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(qed_output_dir, "qm_params"),    showWarnings = FALSE)

summary_rows <- list()
n_row <- 0L

for (model in qed_models) {

   agg_pr  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_pr_",    model, ".csv")))
   agg_tx  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_tasmax_", model, ".csv")))
   agg_tn  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_tasmin_", model, ".csv")))

   for (i in seq_len(nrow(qm_catch))) {
      id   <- qm_catch$id[i]
      tier <- qm_catch$tier[i]

      out_dir <- file.path(qed_output_dir, "qm_corrected", model, tier)
      par_dir <- file.path(qed_output_dir, "qm_params",    model, tier)
      dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      dir.create(par_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

      ref <- forcing_cache[[id]]

      res <- tryCatch({

         for (var in qed_vars) {
            agg   <- switch(var, pr = agg_pr, tasmax = agg_tx, tasmin = agg_tn)
            rcol  <- qed_camels_var_cols[[var]]

            src_all  <- qed_get_series(agg, id)          # full source series
            src_date <- agg$dates
            in_win   <- src_date >= qed_period_start & src_date <= qed_period_end

            # --- Step 5.4: overlap-window sanity check -------------------
            n_overlap_valid <- sum(!is.na(src_all[in_win]))
            if (n_overlap_valid < qed_min_days_for_qm) {
               summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <-
                  data.frame(model, id, var, tier,
                             status = paste0("skipped_overlap_lt_", qed_min_days_for_qm),
                             n_overlap = n_overlap_valid,
                             bins_used = NA_character_,
                             n_extrap = NA_integer_, frac_extrap = NA_real_)
               next
            }

            extrap <- switch(var, pr = qed_extrap_pr,
                             tasmax = qed_extrap_temp, tasmin = qed_extrap_temp)

            # --- Step 5.3: reference restricted to the overlap window -----
            ref_w <- ref[[rcol]][ref$date %in% src_date[in_win]]

            # --- fit on the overlap window, apply to the FULL series ------
            fits <- list(); bins_used <- character(0)
            s_lbl <- qed_date_to_season(src_date[in_win])
            src_w <- src_all[in_win]
            for (s in names(qed_seasons)) {
               # Step 5.8: seasonal fit only if the bin has enough days
               if (sum(s_lbl == s) >= qed_min_quantile_sample) {
                  fits[[s]] <- qed_fit_eqm(src_w[s_lbl == s], ref_w, qed_n_quantiles)
                  if (!is.null(fits[[s]])) bins_used <- c(bins_used, s)
               }
            }
            fallback_annual <- length(bins_used) < length(qed_seasons)
            if (fallback_annual) {
               fits[["annual"]] <- qed_fit_eqm(src_w, ref_w, qed_n_quantiles)
               if (!is.null(fits[["annual"]])) {
                  bins_used <- c(bins_used, "annual(fallback)")
               }
            }

            if (is.null(fits[["annual"]]) && all(vapply(fits[names(qed_seasons)],
                                                        is.null, logical(1)))) {
               summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <-
                  data.frame(model, id, var, tier, status = "skipped_no_fit_possible",
                             n_overlap = n_overlap_valid,
                             bins_used = NA_character_,
                             n_extrap = NA_integer_, frac_extrap = NA_real_)
               next
            }

            # --- Step 6: apply to the FULL source series -------------------
            # Pre-allocate one row per source date, then fill column-wise by
            # season (avoids any row duplication).
            appl <- data.table::data.table(
               x_src      = src_all,
               x_corrected = NA_real_,
               within_range = NA,
               extrapolated_low  = FALSE,
               extrapolated_high = FALSE)
            s_full <- qed_date_to_season(src_date)
            for (s in names(qed_seasons)) {
               w <- which(s_full == s)
               if (!length(w)) next
               f <- fits[[s]]
               if (is.null(f)) f <- fits[["annual"]]   # season bin fell back
               if (is.null(f)) stop(sprintf(
                  "%s/%s/%s: no fit for season %s and no annual fallback",
                  model, id, var, s))
               res <- qed_apply_eqm(src_all[w], f, extrap)
               appl$x_corrected[w]       <- res$x_corrected
               appl$within_range[w]      <- res$within_range
               appl$extrapolated_low[w]  <- res$extrapolated_low
               appl$extrapolated_high[w] <- res$extrapolated_high
            }

            method_flag <- ifelse(is.na(appl$x_src), "source_nan",
                           ifelse(appl$extrapolated_low, "extrapolated_low",
                            ifelse(appl$extrapolated_high, "extrapolated_high",
                                   "within_range")))

            # Acceptance check: corrected NaN only where source NaN
            bad <- sum(is.na(appl$x_corrected) & !is.na(appl$x_src))
            if (bad > 0) stop(sprintf(
               "%s/%s/%s: %d corrected NaN with valid source", model, id, var, bad))

            out <- data.table::data.table(
               date           = src_date,
               source_value   = appl$x_src,
               corrected_value= appl$x_corrected,
               method_flag    = method_flag)
            data.table::fwrite(out,
               file.path(out_dir, paste0(id, "_", var, ".csv")))

            saveRDS(fits, file.path(par_dir, paste0(id, "_", var, ".rds")))

            n_extrap <- sum(appl$extrapolated_low | appl$extrapolated_high)
            summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <-
               data.frame(model, id, var, tier,
                          status = ifelse(fallback_annual,
                                          "fitted_annual_fallback", "fitted"),
                          n_overlap = n_overlap_valid,
                          bins_used = paste(bins_used, collapse = "+"),
                          n_extrap = n_extrap,
                          frac_extrap = round(n_extrap / length(src_date), 4))
         }
         "ok"
      },
      error = function(e) {
         qed_log(paste("ERROR", model, id, conditionMessage(e)), qed_log_file)
         paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
      })
   }

   rm(agg_pr, agg_tx, agg_tn); invisible(gc())
   qed_log(paste("model done:", model), qed_log_file)
}

qm_run_summary <- data.table::rbindlist(summary_rows, fill = TRUE)
data.table::fwrite(qm_run_summary, file.path(qed_output_dir, "qm_run_summary.csv"))
print(table(qm_run_summary$status))
```

## 4. Step 7 -- Tier 3 handling (Option C: exclude & log)

```{r tier3-log}
tier3 <- inventory[grepl("^tier3", final_action)]
tier3_log <- data.frame(
   catchment_id = tier3$id,
   option = "C",
   reason = tier3$final_action,
   availability = tier3$availability_frac,
   n_valid_days = tier3$n_valid_days,
   note = "excluded from QM per Suggestion-workflow.md Step 7 / Option C")
data.table::fwrite(tier3_log, file.path(qed_output_dir, "tier3_handling_log.csv"))
cat("Tier 3 logged:", nrow(tier3_log), "catchments\n")
# LSTM streamflow is NOT used as observed anywhere in this workflow (hard rule 6)
```

## Acceptance checks

```{r checks}
# (a) every Tier1/2 catchment x var has a fitted file or a logged skip
stopifnot(nrow(qm_run_summary) == length(qed_models) * nrow(qm_catch) * length(qed_vars))
# (b) no skip went unlogged (skips are rows in qm_run_summary with status skipped_*)
cat("status counts:\n"); print(table(qm_run_summary$status))
qed_log(paste0("Notebook 20 done. rows=", nrow(qm_run_summary),
               " fitted=", sum(grepl("^fitted", qm_run_summary$status))), qed_log_file)
```
